system.name: agent-contracts
system.purpose: Maintains the Scyvera Agent Contract specification, the Python governance runtime, and the scyvera-ts conformance runtime, and publishes the TypeScript package to the public npm registry under human approval.

capabilities.name: publish_runtime_package
capabilities.description: Publishes @scyvera/scyvera-ts to the public npm registry from a release-triggered workflow, after the maintainer approves the deployment gate.

capabilities.name: verify_package_release
capabilities.description: Checks that the release tag matches the package version and that the runtime conforms to the pinned conformance suite before any artifact is published.

recovery.details: A failed run stops before publication. A bad published version is deprecated and superseded by a fixed patch; published versions are not unpublished.

replay.details: A published version is immutable, so the workflow is never replayed at the same version.

system.name: scyvera
system.purpose: Maintains the Scyvera Agent Contract specification, the Python governance runtime, the scyvera-ts conformance runtime, and the scyvera-rs native Rust runtime, and publishes both runtime packages to their public registries under human approval.

capabilities.name: publish_runtime_package
capabilities.description: Publishes @scyvera/scyvera-ts to the public npm registry from a release-triggered workflow, after the maintainer approves the deployment gate.

capabilities.name: verify_package_release
capabilities.description: Checks that the release tag matches the package version and that the runtime conforms to the pinned conformance suite before any artifact is published.

capabilities.name: publish_native_runtime_package
capabilities.description: Publishes scyvera-rs to the public crates.io registry from a release-triggered workflow, after the maintainer approves the deployment gate. The bootstrap version is uploaded by the maintainer with a short-lived, scoped token, because crates.io requires a token until the crate exists; every later version publishes through OIDC.

side_effects.description: Publishes an immutable version of scyvera-rs.

recovery.details: A failed run stops before publication. A bad published version is deprecated and superseded by a fixed patch; published versions are not unpublished. crates.io is stricter than npm: a version can be yanked but never deleted, so preflight and the approval gate are the only corrections available before upload.

replay.details: A published version is immutable, so the workflow is never replayed at the same version.
